basic.name: Soundwave
basic.description: Deal 105~~0.04~~ damage to enemies in an area and knock them back.

basic.name: Crossfade
basic.description:
Currently playing Speed Boost, increasing the Movement Speed of Lúcio and nearby allied Heroes by 10%.

Toggle to play Healing Boost instead.

basic.name: Amp It Up
basic.description: Raise Lúcio's Crossfade track volume for 3 seconds, amping Healing Boost to 112~~0.04~~ Health per second and Speed Boost to 30% increased Movement Speed.

basic.name: Crossfade
basic.description:
Currently playing Healing Boost, passively healing Lúcio and nearby allied Heroes for 15~~0.04~~ Health per second.

Toggle to play Speed Boost instead.

heroic.name: Sound Barrier
heroic.description: After 1 second, Lúcio and nearby allied Heroes gain a 1488~~0.04~~ point Shield that rapidly decays over 6 seconds.

heroic.name: High Five
heroic.description: Quickly skate to an allied Hero. Upon arrival the ally is healed for 230~~0.04~~, Lúcio is healed for 80~~0.04~~, and both gain Unstoppable for 1 second.

trait.name: Push Off
trait.description: While moving alongside terrain, activate to slide towards a targeted location. Enemies hit take 100~~0.04~~ damage and are Slowed by 75% for 1 second.

mount.name: Wall Ride
mount.description: When moving alongside terrain, Lúcio begins to Wall Ride for 2 seconds. While Wall Ride is active, Lúcio can walk through units and gains 20% Movement Speed that stacks with other bonuses.

activable.name: Boombox
activable.description:
Place a boombox that plays Lúcio's active Crossfade track. Its volume adjusts with Amp It Up. Allied Heroes near the boombox gain 5 Armor.

Crossfade tracks from Lúcio and the Boombox do not stack.

activable.name: Summer Anthem
activable.description: Activate for allies affected by Crossfade to become Unkillable for 2.5 seconds.

level1.name: Party Mix
level1.description:
Quest: Play Lúcio's Crossfade tracks to nearby allies. Multiple allies provide additional time.

Reward: For every 1 Minute played, permanently increase Lúcio's maximum Mana by 10. 
Reward: Once you have played for 8 minutes or more, permanently increase Crossfade's radius by 30%.

level1.name: Accelerando
level1.description: Wall Ride's Movement Speed bonus gradually increases to 40% over 6 seconds while Lúcio maintains its effect.

level1.name: Smooth Moves
level1.description:
While Wall Ride is active, Basic Attacks heal for 30% of the damage dealt and restore 0.5 Mana.

Passive: Increase Wall Ride duration by 1 seconds.

level4.name: Subwoofer
level4.description:
Enemies within the first half of Soundwave's range are knocked back 75% further.

Quest: Hit 3 enemy Heroes with a single Soundwave.

Reward: Increase Soundwave's arc by 50% and its range by 20%.

level4.name: Off the Wall
level4.description: Hitting an enemy with Soundwave while Wall Ride is active sets its cooldown to 5 seconds and refunds 15 Mana.

level4.name: Supersonic
level4.description: While Wall Ride is active, Push Off's cooldown recharges 100% faster.

level7.name: Good Vibrations
level7.description: Hitting an enemy with Soundwave grants Lúcio a 38~~0.04~~ Shield for 8 seconds. Hitting enemy Heroes grants 3 times this amount.

level7.name: Reverse Amp
level7.description:
Blast Lúcio's active Crossfade track at enemy Heroes. While Amp It Up is active, Healing Boost deals 50~~0.04~~ damage per second and Speed Boost Slows by 20%.

This ability is unaffected by Crossfade talents.

level7.name: Boombox
level7.description:
Place a boombox that plays Lúcio's active Crossfade track. Its volume adjusts with Amp It Up. Allied Heroes near the boombox gain 5 Armor.

Crossfade tracks from Lúcio and the Boombox do not stack.

level10.name: Sound Barrier
level10.description: After 1 second, Lúcio and nearby allied Heroes gain a 1488~~0.04~~ point Shield that rapidly decays over 6 seconds.

level10.name: High Five
level10.description: Quickly skate to an allied Hero. Upon arrival the ally is healed for 230~~0.04~~, Lúcio is healed for 80~~0.04~~, and both gain Unstoppable for 1 second.

level13.name: All Together
level13.description: For each ally affected by Crossfade, Lúcio gains 5% Movement Speed that stacks with other bonuses.

level13.name: Heavy Casters
level13.description: Push Off no longer Slows the first Hero hit, and instead Stuns them for 0.5 seconds.

level13.name: Slip
level13.description: While Wall Ride is active, passing near an enemy Hero increases its Movement Speed bonus to 40%, and grants 15 Armor, for 2 second.

level16.name: Rejuvenescência
level16.description: While Amp It Up is active, Crossfade's Healing Boost heals for an additional 2.5% of the target's maximum Health each second.

level16.name: Up the Frequency
level16.description:
Hitting enemy Heroes with Basic Attacks reduces the cooldown of Amp It Up by 0.3 seconds.

Passive: Wall Ride increases Basic Attack range by 2.2.

level16.name: Up To Eleven
level16.description:
Hitting an enemy Hero with Soundwave or Push Off increases the duration of Amp It Up.

Soundwave grants 0.5 seconds and Push Off grants 1 second. If Amp It Up is not active, these bonuses are granted to its next activation, up to 3 seconds.

Passive: Increase the duration of Amp It Up by 1 second.

level20.name: Bossa Nova
level20.description: Reduce the cooldown of Sound Barrier to 30 seconds, but the Shield now decays over 4 seconds.

level20.name: Mixing Fire
level20.description:
High Five can now be cast on enemy Heroes, dealing 160~~0.04~~ damage and reducing all healing received by 50% for 3 seconds.

Passive: Reduce the cost and cooldown of High Five by 30%.

level20.name: House Party
level20.description: For each ally affected by Crossfade, Lúcio gains 8% increased healing.

level20.name: Summer Anthem
level20.description: Activate for allies affected by Crossfade to become Unkillable for 2.5 seconds.
